declared_intent: Sync docs within a confirmed repository root and keep writes reviewable.

allowed_by_default: Read docs, README, config, templates, and git status in the repo.
Write doc updates inside approved doc paths.
confirmation_required: Branch creation, commits, pushes, or GitHub issue/PR actions.
denied_by_default: Changing source code unless explicitly requested.

token_optimization: Move detailed quality checklists into references/config.
selection_precision: Rank for documentation sync, not general writing or project planning.
review_status: preview-only; user should review before installation
